basic_info.description: JUST LISTED!!!  Lovely home on desirable Cayuga Ave.  As you enter the foyer, you are warmly greeted by the hardwood floors.  Stepping into the ample sized living room, you find a wood burning fireplace and the architectural features that make these homes so alluring.  The abundance of natural light is apparent throughout the formal dining room and eat-in kitchen.  The hallway leading back to the two bedrooms and one bathroom is also lit by skylights.  The lower level consists of the 3rd bedroom with an unwarranted bathroom and kitchenette.  For added privacy, this bedroom has a private entrance off of the garage.  The very large, unfinished garage, storage room, and yard are perfect for those with hobbies, a green thumb, or do-it yourselfers.   More pictures to come!
